files.name: cnpc_tacz_fire-0.1.0.jar
files.html:
Initial release.

  • Added CustomNPCs + TACZ firing bridge
  • Added per-NPC configuration GUI
  • Added ranged/melee/auto stance policy
  • Added script and storeddata integration
  • Added ammo stock and reload policy
  • Added RPM control
  • Added melee weapon selection
  • Added optional grenade configuration support
